name: Axiom SkyBridge Tether Car
description: A private cable car system connecting the penthouse levels of Tier 5 residential towers to corporate headquarters — a direct line from bedroom to boardroom without descending to any level where common people exist. The Tether Cars are enclosed in privacy glass, temperature-controlled, and travel at 50 km/h on dedicated cables strung between the tops of the tallest buildings. From the ground, they look like jewels sliding across spider silk, hundreds of meters in the air. They are the ultimate expression of vertical segregation — the rich don't just live above everyone else, they commute above everyone else.
propulsion: Cable-drawn, electric motor at each terminal
range: Individual spans: 500m-3 km between tower tops
armament: Privacy glass, signal shielding, emergency descent system.
common_usage: Executive commuting without ground exposure, private inter-tower transit, never having to see a Tier 1 resident.
story_hooks: A Tether Car cable is severed mid-transit and the emergency descent drops a Tier 5 executive into a Tier 1 district for the first time in their life
Someone is intercepting Tether Car communications by tapping the cable vibrations — the most analog hack in the most digital city
